name: Leaked Environment
objective: Find sensitive values inside a project folder before it is shared.
brief: A developer is preparing a support ZIP and accidentally included environment files and logs with synthetic secrets.
success_criteria: Identify synthetic API and database secrets.

artifacts.content: {{CREATED_AT}} INFO user demo@example.invalid logged in\n{{CREATED_AT}} DEBUG token={{FAKE_TOKEN}}\n

# Support Package

This folder is intended to be sent to support. Review before sharing.

hints: Look for hidden or dot-prefixed files.
Logs often repeat values that were already present in configuration files.
The safe action is redaction, not deletion of the entire package.
solution: The support package includes a .env file and logs containing synthetic credentials. These values must be redacted or replaced with placeholders before the folder is shared.
